In this direct public-company pass, few obvious US-listed companies in the preferred USD 300M-10B range were found for retimers, AECs, CXL/PCIe connectivity, and AI fabric switching; the node appears public-market concentrated in larger-cap names or private/non-US suppliers.

node: Retimers, active electrical cables, CXL/PCIe connectivity, and AI fabric switching
summary: This pass finds that the most direct US-listed exposure to AI-cluster connectivity silicon is already concentrated in visible semiconductor/connectivity names rather than obscure sub-$10B public companies. Astera Labs is the reference pure-play for PCIe/CXL retimers, smart cable modules, Ethernet smart cable modules, and AI fabric switches. Credo is the closest underfollowed-to-reference bridge through active electrical cables, optical DSPs, SerDes, and AI/hyperscale connectivity. Rambus is a less obvious IP-layer candidate for PCIe/CXL controllers and retimer-controller IP. MACOM is a second-order direct silicon candidate where PCIe/CXL-over-optical chipsets could matter as copper reach limits emerge. No buy/sell recommendation is made; these are research candidates for further evidence collection.
